tech_depth.evidence: Screenshot 2 lists 7 automated checks mapped to specific code (scripts/validate.mjs, lib/guild.ts, validate.yml), PR author vs profile account matching, CI-bot-committed AI scores, and measured 'PR checks 30, 1 rejected, median 29s'. Serverless design is explained. No performance or design-tradeoff analysis beyond that.
tech_depth.fix: Add a short write-up of why a no-server Git/Actions architecture was chosen, with its limits at scale (e.g. API rate limits, build time with 1,000 profiles).

traction.evidence: Screenshot 1 shows 'beta · 1 registered developer' and the only profile is the author's own, with 보증 0. Only CI run counts are given; there are no user figures. GitHub metrics: 1 repo, 0 stars.
traction.fix: Get 10 real developers to register via PR and publish the count with dates, plus any visitor numbers from analytics.

differentiation.evidence: The angle of requiring a public evidence link for every claim, with CI link checks and account-ownership marks, differs from generic portfolio sites (bio, screenshot 2). But it is unproven at scale, with no unique data or external contributions.
differentiation.fix: Show a concrete case where the checks caught a fake or dead claim, and compare to LinkedIn or GitHub profiles side by side.

evidence.evidence: Two live URLs work (screenshots 1 and 2), the site links to actual CI run records and a rejected run, and claims map to code files. The bio paragraph is long and dense. The GitHub repo link is not given explicitly in the profile.
evidence.fix: Put the repo URL and a 30-second demo of a PR being accepted/rejected at the top; shorten the bio to 3 numeric bullets.

commercial.evidence: Both products have mrr_band 'none'. Nav shows a '기업·투자자' section, but no pricing, target customer segment or revenue model is visible. Customers are vague.
commercial.fix: State one target buyer (e.g. startup recruiters), a price, and collect a waitlist or pilot commitment.

design.evidence: Screenshot 1 has a clear dark hero with a big headline, two CTAs, a sample profile card and consistent nav. Screenshot 2 has a clean stat cards plus claim/method/code table. The globe overlaps the headline slightly, and the page has a large empty area below the fold.
design.fix: Fix the globe/headline overlap and add contrast to secondary text; fill the empty hero space with a proof metric.

innovation.evidence: Enforcing evidence at PR time through GitHub Actions and showing ownership-verified links is a modestly new take on resumes (screenshot 2). Verification-based profiles are an existing idea, and the approach is simple link checks.
innovation.fix: Add a verification that goes beyond link liveness, such as checking that a repo's commits or deployed app truly belong to the claimant, and demo it.

summary.en: A coherent, honestly scoped verification-first resume platform with real CI checks and a few measured figures (30 PR runs, 1 rejection, 29s median). It has no users, no revenue, 1 registered developer, 0 stars and no demonstrated market traction.
summary.ko: 증거 기반 이력서 플랫폼으로 CI 검증 구조가 구체적이고 한계까지 솔직히 밝혔으며 일부 측정치(PR 검사 30회, 거절 1회, 중앙값 29초)가 있습니다. 다만 사용자·매출·시장 반응이 없고 등록 개발자 1명, 스타 0개입니다.
